name: WriteText.ai
author: WriteText.ai

sections.description:
WriteText.ai generates product descriptions, category descriptions, short descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph text, image alt text, and enriched product attributes, all from one platform.

This plugin is the WooCommerce integration for WriteText.ai. It connects your store to the platform, keeps your products and categories in sync, and receives finished content and enriched attributes back into WooCommerce. The work happens at platform.writetext.ai.

This matters because shoppers no longer only look in one place. They browse and search the classic way, turn to an AI for answers, or let an AI agent do all the work for them. All three reward the same thing: complete, structured, well-written product data. That is what Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) come down to for an ecommerce catalog, and it is what WriteText.ai produces.

One subscription, one account, up to 20 webshops. Full automation from enrichment through to publishing, reusable templates, brand voices, and 29 languages.

Key Platform Highlights in Version 5

  • ✅ Attribute enrichment: WriteText.ai now completes and improves your product data before any text is written. Fill empty attributes, review existing values, or discover new attributes your products don’t have yet, so your content starts from better information.
  • ✅ One platform for every webshop: Sign in once and work across up to 20 connected WooCommerce, Shopify, or Magento webshops. Each webshop gets its own home page, settings, and workspace.
  • ✅ Publishing beyond your webshop: Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center directly from the platform. Other sales channels, such as Meta, Lazada, eBay, and Microsoft Merchant Center are being rolled out gradually.
  • ✅ Bring your own AI key (BYOK): Connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key, choose the model for each task, and pay your provider directly. Set one key for the account or a different one per webshop.
  • ✅ Users, roles, and access: Invite your team and give each person one of five built-in roles, or create your own custom role. Choose which webshops they can work with, and what they can view or change.
  • ✅ Simpler pricing: One subscription with every feature included, and pay only for what you use.
  • ✅ Improved full automation: Attribute enrichment, keyword analysis, and text generation now run in one streamlined workflow, with a guided setup and a review step before anything starts.
  • ✅ Improved new product detection: New products are automatically detected and can be enriched, written, and sent to your webshop without manual intervention.
  • ✅ Better reports: See who changed what, track every unit spent, and identify which products need work for AI search visibility.

Why Choose WriteText.ai?

WriteText.ai is built for real ecommerce operations, not just copy generation.

It covers three stages that connect: it enriches your raw product data, writes the content on top of it, then publishes the result to WooCommerce and to your sales channels, across thousands of products while maintaining your brand’s authentic voice.

You’ll get:
* 🧬 Complete product data: Attribute enrichment fills gaps, corrects existing values, and discovers new attributes using image analysis, online research, and your existing content.
* 🎨 Brand voice consistency: Create custom brand voices that ensure every product sounds authentically like your brand.
* 🔍 Smarter SEO, AEO, and GEO: Keyword pipelines that evolve from easy-to-rank terms to high-value targets, with structured content for answer engines and generative AI systems.
* 🤖 Full automation: Detect new products, enrich attributes, analyze keywords, generate, and send to webshop automatically.
* 🏗️ Custom templates: Structured layouts with reusable blocks (introductions, features, FAQs, images) and overall instructions for complete control.
* 🌍 Multilingual power: 29 languages with cultural tone and phrasing adjustments.
* ⚙️ Built for large catalogs: Process thousands of products in the background while you keep working. If anything interrupts the run, it picks up where it left off.
* 📦 Product type support: Generate content suited to how each product is structured and sold, including simple, bundled, grouped, variable, and external products.
* 🛒 Reach beyond your store: Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center, with more sales channels rolling out.
* 🔐 Bring your own AI key: Use WriteText.ai units, or connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key and pay your provider directly.

Main Features

🧬 Attribute Enrichment

Better product data means better text. WriteText.ai finds and completes your product attributes before any content is written, so your descriptions are more accurate and more specific, and your products are easier to surface in traditional search, AI search, and agentic commerce.

  • Three enrichment modes: Fill gaps completes empty attributes, Review and update completes attributes and checks the values you already have for possible improvements, and Expand and discover reviews existing attributes and suggests attributes your products don’t have yet
  • Missing product identifier lookup for GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN
  • Source priority you control: arrange AI image analysis, AI online research, and extraction from existing content into the order you prefer
  • Enrichable attributes such as color and material can be enriched and edited, while operational attributes such as price and stock stay read-only so they never change by accident
  • See what WriteText.ai found side by side with the value currently in your webshop, and choose which one to keep
  • Approval settings per webshop: auto-approve everything, review only changed values, or review every value yourself
  • Approving a value and sending it to your webshop are separate steps, so nothing goes live before you are ready
  • Attribute library for reviewing and enriching specific attributes, such as material or size, across every product that uses it
  • Upload attributes and values from a file to fill your catalog quickly
  • Attribute sets to group related attributes and assign them to a product or to a whole category at once

🧩 Bulk AI Content Generation

Generate descriptions, meta tags, Open Graph text, and image alt text in one pass, or target specific fields.

  • Multi-selection across filters and pages
  • Bulk keyword optimization and generation modes
  • Your new text sits next to the text currently in your webshop, so you can compare before you send
  • Character and word counts to help you stay within search limits
  • Pick which enriched attributes guide the writing, and turn online research and image analysis on or off per run
  • Failed deliveries are handled automatically, with retries managed by the platform
  • Work runs in the background and the task list shows you where everything stands, so you can keep working, pause all tasks, or cancel the ones you no longer need

Category bulk actions

  • Bulk keyword analysis: run keyword analysis across multiple categories at once; WriteText.ai identifies the target keywords for each and adds results to the pipeline
  • Bulk generation: generate descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, and Open Graph text across a selection of categories in one run
  • Bulk send to webshop: send generated content to your store for multiple categories at once
  • Full automation: enable automated keyword analysis, content generation, and publishing without manual intervention

🔄 Full Automation

Set and forget. Automatically detect new products, enrich their attributes, run keyword analysis, generate optimized texts, and send them to WooCommerce.

  • Guided four-step setup covering attribute enrichment, keyword analysis, text generation, and a final summary, with the option to skip any step you don’t need
  • A review screen shows every step and its settings before anything runs, and nothing starts until you confirm
  • Choose whether attributes, text, or both are sent to your webshop
  • Daily detection of new and updated products at a time you choose
  • Published products update live, and drafts stay drafts until you are ready

🧱 Template Builder + Custom Prompts

Create visually structured, SEO-optimized layouts that match your brand’s tone.

  • Overall template instructions for global guidance across all sections
  • Section-based prompts (e.g., Features, FAQs, Specs, Image captions)
  • HTML and CSS-ready output
  • Integrated image blocks with automatic alt text
  • Web research options (basic and advanced) for content enrichment
  • People Also Ask (PAA) question blocks: add PAA questions sourced from search data as individual content blocks, each generating a focused answer in paragraph or bullet format with an optional heading
  • FAQ questions can be sourced from PAA data, so the questions generated reflect real search behavior rather than being inferred from the product information alone

🎨 Brand Voice for Authentic Content

Create custom brand voices that define how all your generated content should sound, ensuring consistency across every product, category, and store.

  • Select between 5 and 15 representative products from your connected webshops or upload product data via CSV
  • Provide brand documents, marketing copy, or style guides as PDFs for AI analysis
  • Connect brand voices to one or more stores for centralized brand management
  • Brand voice integrates seamlessly with templates, automation, multilingual generation, and bulk processing
  • Edit existing brand voices at any point to update tone, vocabulary, or style instructions as your approach evolves

📦 Product type support

WriteText.ai recognizes the product type it is generating content for and adjusts its output accordingly.

  • Supported product types: simple, bundled, grouped, variable, and external
  • Descriptions and meta fields are generated to match how each product type is structured and sold
  • No additional setup is required. WriteText.ai reads the product type from your store automatically

🔑 SEO, AEO & GEO Optimization

Built for Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):

  • Structured Q&A and FAQ sections for higher AI visibility
  • People Also Ask (PAA) question blocks for targeted answer content in templates
  • FAQ questions sourced from PAA data for FAQs grounded in real search behavior
  • Keyword and negative keyword management
  • Intent-based optimization for voice and AI search
  • Competitor and traffic potential insights
  • Improved keyword analysis: better evaluation and ranking of keyword candidates surfaces terms that more closely match real search demand
  • AEO and GEO report: review text freshness and check whether your products include FAQs and People Also Ask content, so you can prioritize which pages need work for AI search visibility

🖼️ Image Intelligence

Enrich your content visually with AI image analysis and alt text generation.

  • Featured image and gallery image alt text support, covering up to 22 images per product
  • Automatic alt text regeneration during bulk or full automation
  • Image analysis as an enrichment source, turning visual details into usable product attributes
  • Images are retrieved from your webshop and processed by the platform for analysis and alt text generation

🛒 Sales Channels

Your content no longer has to stop at your webshop.

  • Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center by connecting your account directly
  • Other sales channels, such as Meta, Lazada, eBay, and Microsoft Merchant Center, are being rolled out gradually
  • See each channel’s status, feed completeness, and open issues in one view
  • Connecting a channel and publishing to it do not consume units

🔐 Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)

Already have an AI provider account? Use it, and pay your provider directly.

  • Connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key, encrypted before it is stored
  • Choose the model for each task, such as product research, text generation, attribute enrichment, and more, or keep the recommended defaults
  • Use your WriteText.ai units first, then switch to your own key automatically
  • Set one key for the whole account, or a different provider per webshop, which helps agencies keep client costs separate
  • The token usage report shows every request by action, user, provider, and model
  • Keyword analysis always uses WriteText.ai units, even when your own key is connected

👥 Users, Roles & Access

  • Five built-in roles: main account holder, administrator, editor, contributor, and viewer
  • Create your own roles when you need a different mix of permissions
  • Choose which webshops each person can work on, so teams and clients only see what’s theirs

📊 Reports

  • Text generation history showing every text saved or sent to your webshop, with the person who made the change and the date, exportable whenever you need a record
  • GEO and AEO report showing how fresh each product’s text is and whether it includes FAQs and People Also Ask questions

🌐 Multi-Language and Multi-Webshop

  • Supports 29 languages
  • Connect up to 20 WooCommerce, Shopify, or Magento webshops to one account
  • Each webshop has its own home page, settings, and workspace, covering tones, style, audiences, brand voice, attributes, automation, and BYOK
  • Product and category counts and last sync time at a glance, with one-click fetch when your catalog changes

Other Details

WriteText.ai relies on third-party services to fulfill different functions. The WriteText.ai platform at https://platform.writetext.ai communicates with the WooCommerce integration to handle:

  • Connecting to the appropriate regional server to ensure performance
  • Validating the user’s subscription and monitoring unit balance
  • Calculating the unit cost for certain actions
  • Getting up-to-date keyword data
  • Conducting real-time web research
  • Enriching product attributes
  • Generating text
  • Fetching history log

A valid WriteText.ai account is required. You can read the Terms of Service and the Privacy Notice on our website.

Plans & Units

One subscription includes every feature. There are no tiers to compare and nothing to upgrade to unlock.

  • Free trial: 14 days with 1,000,000 units to try everything on 10 products from your own catalog.
  • Subscription: $99 a month or $999 a year, with every feature included.
  • Add-on units: Buy from $10 or any custom amount, and turn on auto top-up so your work doesn’t stop when your balance runs low.
  • Bring your own key: Use your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic API key for supported AI tasks and pay your provider directly. Keyword analysis continues to use WriteText.ai units.
  • Managed setup: A one-time $999 package with guided setup, tailored templates, a dedicated account manager, and one-to-one training.

Units replace credits. A unit is much smaller than a credit, so small tasks are charged for just what they use. Existing credit balances convert at 15,000 units per credit.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.7 or later. Tested up to 7.1.5.
  • PHP version 7.4 or later. Tested up to 8.5.
  • WooCommerce 8.2 or later. Tested up to 11.3.1.

SEO plugins

An SEO plugin is required to generate meta titles, meta descriptions, and Open Graph text. Without one, WriteText.ai can still generate product descriptions, short descriptions, and category descriptions.

  • Yoast SEO 20.7 or later. Tested up to 28.9.
  • All in One SEO 4.3.9 or later. Tested up to 5.0.5.1.
  • Rank Math SEO 1.0.114 or later. Tested up to 1.0.282.

Optional multilingual integrations

For multilingual stores, WriteText.ai supports the following plugins. Neither is required for a single-language store.

  • Polylang 3.3.2 or later. Tested up to 3.9.2.
  • WPML Multilingual CMS 4.6.2 or later. Tested up to 5.4.0. Also tested with WPML Multilingual & Multicurrency for WooCommerce 5.9.0.

Product bundles

Other bundling plugins are not supported. When an unsupported bundling plugin is used, WriteText.ai treats the product as a standard product and does not identify its component products.

  • Product Bundles for WooCommerce 8.5.5 or later. Tested up to 8.5.9.
sections.faq:
Where do I work in version 5?

You sign in at https://platform.writetext.ai and work there. The WooCommerce integration keeps your store connected, syncs your products and categories, and receives the finished text and attributes back. Version 5 brings the work into one place, so you can manage every connected webshop from a single account instead of inside each store’s admin.

What is attribute enrichment?

Before version 5, WriteText.ai used your product data to write your text, but the data itself stayed as it was. Attribute enrichment completes and improves that data first, so your text starts from better information. You choose how far it goes: fill empty attributes only, also review the values you already have, or also suggest attributes your products don’t have yet. Complete, structured product data also helps your products show up in traditional search, AI search, and agentic commerce.

Operational attributes such as price and stock come from your webshop and stay read-only, so they are never changed by mistake. Approving an enriched value and sending it to your webshop are separate steps.

What basis does WriteText.ai use to generate product texts?

WriteText.ai uses your store’s product information and your selected generation settings to create search-optimized, brand-aligned content. Depending on the inputs available and the features you enable, this can include:

  • Product names, selected product data, and enriched attributes
  • AI image analysis and online product research
  • Target keywords
  • Special instructions and additional product details you provide
  • Your selected template, tone, style, or Brand Voice

You can generate text without adding extra instructions. Clicking “Generate” uses the product information and settings already selected. Providing accurate product details, running attribute enrichment, and analyzing keywords beforehand can help produce more relevant and tailored results.

How does WriteText.ai help with SEO, AEO, and GEO?

For SEO, WriteText.ai uses keyword analysis, competitor insights, negative keywords, and intent detection to support your SEO strategy. For AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), it generates structured layouts with headings, bullet points, FAQs, Q&A sections, and People Also Ask question blocks, making your product pages easier to surface in AI chatbots, voice assistants, and search engine answer boxes. FAQ questions can also be sourced from PAA data, so the questions in your content reflect what people are actively searching for rather than being generated from product information alone. For GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), it structures content so that your product pages are more likely to be cited or summarized accurately by generative AI systems.

Can I customize the look and feel of the generated content?

Yes. WriteText.ai lets you build reusable templates with structured sections such as introductions, features, specs, usage tips, FAQs, People Also Ask question blocks, and image blocks. Each section is wrapped in a CSS class, so you can apply your own styling or map sections to page builder elements, giving generated text a look and feel that fits your brand.

How accurate is the AI-generated text?

The more product data, keywords, and images you provide, the more accurate the output. Attribute enrichment, product research, and AI image analysis further improve accuracy when attributes are incomplete, which is why running enrichment before generation is recommended. WriteText.ai balances creativity with factual grounding for high-quality content.

Can WriteText.ai automatically update my product texts?

Yes. With automation enabled, WriteText.ai can detect new products, enrich their attributes, analyze their keywords, generate SEO-, AEO-, and GEO-ready text, and send it directly to WooCommerce. You choose whether attributes, text, or both are sent. Content can also be automatically refreshed based on ranking changes or time-based triggers, keeping your catalog optimized without manual rewriting.

Does WriteText.ai support multiple languages?

Yes. WriteText.ai supports 29 languages, with automatic detection based on your WooCommerce store’s language. If a language is not supported, it defaults to English.

Can I use WriteText.ai on multiple webshops?

Yes. You can connect and manage up to 20 WooCommerce, Shopify, or Magento webshops under one WriteText.ai account, making it suitable for agencies, brands with multiple sites, or multi-store setups. Contact us if you need more than 20. Each webshop keeps its own settings, and you can choose which webshops each team member can work on.

Can I use my own AI provider?

Yes. With Bring Your Own Key (BYOK), you can connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic API key and pay your provider directly instead of consuming WriteText.ai units. Your key is encrypted before it is stored, and you can pick which model handles each task. You can set one key for the whole account or a different one per webshop. Keyword analysis always uses WriteText.ai units, even when your own key is connected.

Where can my content be published?

To your WooCommerce store, and to your connected sales channels. Google Merchant Center can be connected directly. Meta, Lazada, eBay, and Microsoft Merchant Center are available on request while we roll them out. Connecting a channel and publishing to it do not consume units.

short_description: WooCommerce AI for SEO, AEO, and GEO. Enrich attributes, generate content, and send to your webshop, Google Merchant Center, and sales channels.
description:
WriteText.ai generates product descriptions, category descriptions, short descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph text, image alt text, and enriched product attributes, all from one platform.

This plugin is the WooCommerce integration for WriteText.ai. It connects your store to the platform, keeps your products and categories in sync, and receives finished content and enriched attributes back into WooCommerce. The work happens at platform.writetext.ai.

This matters because shoppers no longer only look in one place. They browse and search the classic way, turn to an AI for answers, or let an AI agent do all the work for them. All three reward the same thing: complete, structured, well-written product data. That is what Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) come down to for an ecommerce catalog, and it is what WriteText.ai produces.

One subscription, one account, up to 20 webshops. Full automation from enrichment through to publishing, reusable templates, brand voices, and 29 languages.

Key Platform Highlights in Version 5

  • ✅ Attribute enrichment: WriteText.ai now completes and improves your product data before any text is written. Fill empty attributes, review existing values, or discover new attributes your products don’t have yet, so your content starts from better information.
  • ✅ One platform for every webshop: Sign in once and work across up to 20 connected WooCommerce, Shopify, or Magento webshops. Each webshop gets its own home page, settings, and workspace.
  • ✅ Publishing beyond your webshop: Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center directly from the platform. Other sales channels, such as Meta, Lazada, eBay, and Microsoft Merchant Center are being rolled out gradually.
  • ✅ Bring your own AI key (BYOK): Connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key, choose the model for each task, and pay your provider directly. Set one key for the account or a different one per webshop.
  • ✅ Users, roles, and access: Invite your team and give each person one of five built-in roles, or create your own custom role. Choose which webshops they can work with, and what they can view or change.
  • ✅ Simpler pricing: One subscription with every feature included, and pay only for what you use.
  • ✅ Improved full automation: Attribute enrichment, keyword analysis, and text generation now run in one streamlined workflow, with a guided setup and a review step before anything starts.
  • ✅ Improved new product detection: New products are automatically detected and can be enriched, written, and sent to your webshop without manual intervention.
  • ✅ Better reports: See who changed what, track every unit spent, and identify which products need work for AI search visibility.

Why Choose WriteText.ai?

WriteText.ai is built for real ecommerce operations, not just copy generation.

It covers three stages that connect: it enriches your raw product data, writes the content on top of it, then publishes the result to WooCommerce and to your sales channels, across thousands of products while maintaining your brand’s authentic voice.

You’ll get:
* 🧬 Complete product data: Attribute enrichment fills gaps, corrects existing values, and discovers new attributes using image analysis, online research, and your existing content.
* 🎨 Brand voice consistency: Create custom brand voices that ensure every product sounds authentically like your brand.
* 🔍 Smarter SEO, AEO, and GEO: Keyword pipelines that evolve from easy-to-rank terms to high-value targets, with structured content for answer engines and generative AI systems.
* 🤖 Full automation: Detect new products, enrich attributes, analyze keywords, generate, and send to webshop automatically.
* 🏗️ Custom templates: Structured layouts with reusable blocks (introductions, features, FAQs, images) and overall instructions for complete control.
* 🌍 Multilingual power: 29 languages with cultural tone and phrasing adjustments.
* ⚙️ Built for large catalogs: Process thousands of products in the background while you keep working. If anything interrupts the run, it picks up where it left off.
* 📦 Product type support: Generate content suited to how each product is structured and sold, including simple, bundled, grouped, variable, and external products.
* 🛒 Reach beyond your store: Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center, with more sales channels rolling out.
* 🔐 Bring your own AI key: Use WriteText.ai units, or connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key and pay your provider directly.

Main Features

🧬 Attribute Enrichment

Better product data means better text. WriteText.ai finds and completes your product attributes before any content is written, so your descriptions are more accurate and more specific, and your products are easier to surface in traditional search, AI search, and agentic commerce.

  • Three enrichment modes: Fill gaps completes empty attributes, Review and update completes attributes and checks the values you already have for possible improvements, and Expand and discover reviews existing attributes and suggests attributes your products don’t have yet
  • Missing product identifier lookup for GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN
  • Source priority you control: arrange AI image analysis, AI online research, and extraction from existing content into the order you prefer
  • Enrichable attributes such as color and material can be enriched and edited, while operational attributes such as price and stock stay read-only so they never change by accident
  • See what WriteText.ai found side by side with the value currently in your webshop, and choose which one to keep
  • Approval settings per webshop: auto-approve everything, review only changed values, or review every value yourself
  • Approving a value and sending it to your webshop are separate steps, so nothing goes live before you are ready
  • Attribute library for reviewing and enriching specific attributes, such as material or size, across every product that uses it
  • Upload attributes and values from a file to fill your catalog quickly
  • Attribute sets to group related attributes and assign them to a product or to a whole category at once

🧩 Bulk AI Content Generation

Generate descriptions, meta tags, Open Graph text, and image alt text in one pass, or target specific fields.

  • Multi-selection across filters and pages
  • Bulk keyword optimization and generation modes
  • Your new text sits next to the text currently in your webshop, so you can compare before you send
  • Character and word counts to help you stay within search limits
  • Pick which enriched attributes guide the writing, and turn online research and image analysis on or off per run
  • Failed deliveries are handled automatically, with retries managed by the platform
  • Work runs in the background and the task list shows you where everything stands, so you can keep working, pause all tasks, or cancel the ones you no longer need

Category bulk actions

  • Bulk keyword analysis: run keyword analysis across multiple categories at once; WriteText.ai identifies the target keywords for each and adds results to the pipeline
  • Bulk generation: generate descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, and Open Graph text across a selection of categories in one run
  • Bulk send to webshop: send generated content to your store for multiple categories at once
  • Full automation: enable automated keyword analysis, content generation, and publishing without manual intervention

🔄 Full Automation

Set and forget. Automatically detect new products, enrich their attributes, run keyword analysis, generate optimized texts, and send them to WooCommerce.

  • Guided four-step setup covering attribute enrichment, keyword analysis, text generation, and a final summary, with the option to skip any step you don’t need
  • A review screen shows every step and its settings before anything runs, and nothing starts until you confirm
  • Choose whether attributes, text, or both are sent to your webshop
  • Daily detection of new and updated products at a time you choose
  • Published products update live, and drafts stay drafts until you are ready

🧱 Template Builder + Custom Prompts

Create visually structured, SEO-optimized layouts that match your brand’s tone.

  • Overall template instructions for global guidance across all sections
  • Section-based prompts (e.g., Features, FAQs, Specs, Image captions)
  • HTML and CSS-ready output
  • Integrated image blocks with automatic alt text
  • Web research options (basic and advanced) for content enrichment
  • People Also Ask (PAA) question blocks: add PAA questions sourced from search data as individual content blocks, each generating a focused answer in paragraph or bullet format with an optional heading
  • FAQ questions can be sourced from PAA data, so the questions generated reflect real search behavior rather than being inferred from the product information alone

🎨 Brand Voice for Authentic Content

Create custom brand voices that define how all your generated content should sound, ensuring consistency across every product, category, and store.

  • Select between 5 and 15 representative products from your connected webshops or upload product data via CSV
  • Provide brand documents, marketing copy, or style guides as PDFs for AI analysis
  • Connect brand voices to one or more stores for centralized brand management
  • Brand voice integrates seamlessly with templates, automation, multilingual generation, and bulk processing
  • Edit existing brand voices at any point to update tone, vocabulary, or style instructions as your approach evolves

📦 Product type support

WriteText.ai recognizes the product type it is generating content for and adjusts its output accordingly.

  • Supported product types: simple, bundled, grouped, variable, and external
  • Descriptions and meta fields are generated to match how each product type is structured and sold
  • No additional setup is required. WriteText.ai reads the product type from your store automatically

🔑 SEO, AEO & GEO Optimization

Built for Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):

  • Structured Q&A and FAQ sections for higher AI visibility
  • People Also Ask (PAA) question blocks for targeted answer content in templates
  • FAQ questions sourced from PAA data for FAQs grounded in real search behavior
  • Keyword and negative keyword management
  • Intent-based optimization for voice and AI search
  • Competitor and traffic potential insights
  • Improved keyword analysis: better evaluation and ranking of keyword candidates surfaces terms that more closely match real search demand
  • AEO and GEO report: review text freshness and check whether your products include FAQs and People Also Ask content, so you can prioritize which pages need work for AI search visibility

🖼️ Image Intelligence

Enrich your content visually with AI image analysis and alt text generation.

  • Featured image and gallery image alt text support, covering up to 22 images per product
  • Automatic alt text regeneration during bulk or full automation
  • Image analysis as an enrichment source, turning visual details into usable product attributes
  • Images are retrieved from your webshop and processed by the platform for analysis and alt text generation

🛒 Sales Channels

Your content no longer has to stop at your webshop.

  • Publish enriched product data to Google Merchant Center by connecting your account directly
  • Other sales channels, such as Meta, Lazada, eBay, and Microsoft Merchant Center, are being rolled out gradually
  • See each channel’s status, feed completeness, and open issues in one view
  • Connecting a channel and publishing to it do not consume units

🔐 Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)

Already have an AI provider account? Use it, and pay your provider directly.

  • Connect your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic key, encrypted before it is stored
  • Choose the model for each task, such as product research, text generation, attribute enrichment, and more, or keep the recommended defaults
  • Use your WriteText.ai units first, then switch to your own key automatically
  • Set one key for the whole account, or a different provider per webshop, which helps agencies keep client costs separate
  • The token usage report shows every request by action, user, provider, and model
  • Keyword analysis always uses WriteText.ai units, even when your own key is connected

👥 Users, Roles & Access

  • Five built-in roles: main account holder, administrator, editor, contributor, and viewer
  • Create your own roles when you need a different mix of permissions
  • Choose which webshops each person can work on, so teams and clients only see what’s theirs

📊 Reports

  • Text generation history showing every text saved or sent to your webshop, with the person who made the change and the date, exportable whenever you need a record
  • GEO and AEO report showing how fresh each product’s text is and whether it includes FAQs and People Also Ask questions

🌐 Multi-Language and Multi-Webshop

  • Supports 29 languages
  • Connect up to 20 WooCommerce, Shopify, or Magento webshops to one account
  • Each webshop has its own home page, settings, and workspace, covering tones, style, audiences, brand voice, attributes, automation, and BYOK
  • Product and category counts and last sync time at a glance, with one-click fetch when your catalog changes

Other Details

WriteText.ai relies on third-party services to fulfill different functions. The WriteText.ai platform at https://platform.writetext.ai communicates with the WooCommerce integration to handle:

  • Connecting to the appropriate regional server to ensure performance
  • Validating the user’s subscription and monitoring unit balance
  • Calculating the unit cost for certain actions
  • Getting up-to-date keyword data
  • Conducting real-time web research
  • Enriching product attributes
  • Generating text
  • Fetching history log

A valid WriteText.ai account is required. You can read the Terms of Service and the Privacy Notice on our website.

Plans & Units

One subscription includes every feature. There are no tiers to compare and nothing to upgrade to unlock.

  • Free trial: 14 days with 1,000,000 units to try everything on 10 products from your own catalog.
  • Subscription: $99 a month or $999 a year, with every feature included.
  • Add-on units: Buy from $10 or any custom amount, and turn on auto top-up so your work doesn’t stop when your balance runs low.
  • Bring your own key: Use your own OpenAI, xAI, or Anthropic API key for supported AI tasks and pay your provider directly. Keyword analysis continues to use WriteText.ai units.
  • Managed setup: A one-time $999 package with guided setup, tailored templates, a dedicated account manager, and one-to-one training.

Units replace credits. A unit is much smaller than a credit, so small tasks are charged for just what they use. Existing credit balances convert at 15,000 units per credit.
